context.label: Belief and unbelief in the wilderness

observations.body: Israel sees Egypt defeated, fears the LORD, and believes in the LORD and in Moses after passing through the sea.
observations.label: Israel believes after the sea

observations.body: The passage presents israel believes after the sea as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: israel believes after the sea

observations.body: The passage places deliverance and belief beside israel believes after the sea.
observations.label: deliverance and belief

payload.posture: Read Exodus 14:26–31 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The next wilderness crises make clear that witnessed deliverance does not settle every later act of trust.
